history: Also called a Mexican Flag or Traffic Light for the band of red through the middle.
whyItWorks: Anise, agave and capsaicin arrive in sequence rather than together, which is what makes it survivable.
steps: Pour the tequila into a shot glass.
Lay the hot sauce across the surface.
Layer by pouring each ingredient slowly over the back of a bar spoon so it floats on the one below. Sambuca on top.
name: Flatliner
description: Tequila under sambuca, with a line of hot sauce between them.
